heading.one: You missed {gap} mark. Here's where it went.
heading.many: You missed {gap} marks. Here's where they went.

headingNone: You didn't miss a mark this session.

changed_from_right.label: Right, then changed
changed_from_right.do: Change an answer only when you can point to the line that proves it wrong.

struck_key.label: Crossed out the key
struck_key.do: Before you cross out an option, name the word in it that makes it wrong.

never_opened.label: Never opened
never_opened.do: Open every question once before you go deep on any.

long_stay.label: 2 minutes or more, still lost
long_stay.do: At 2 minutes, mark it for review and move on. Come back at the end.

quick_wrong.label: Wrong in under 20 seconds
quick_wrong.do: Read the whole question before you look at the options.

other_wrong.label: Other wrong answers
other_wrong.do: Each one has a repair below: the trap, why the key is right and one rule to keep.

other_blank.label: Opened, left blank
other_blank.do: Where you can rule out one of four options, choosing among the other three averages 1 mark a question under +5 for right and −1 for wrong.

wrong.label: Wrong answers
wrong.do: Each one has a repair below: the trap, why the key is right and one rule to keep.

blank.label: Blanks
blank.do: Where you can rule out one of four options, choosing among the other three averages 1 mark a question under +5 for right and −1 for wrong.

held.label: Under re-check or corrected
held.do: These are being re-checked or were corrected, so they are not sorted by how they were lost.
